level1.text: A horizontal net force of $6.0\,\text{N}$ acts on a toy car of mass $2.5\,\text{kg}$. What is the acceleration of the toy car?
A cyclist and a bicycle with a total mass of $80\,\text{kg}$ accelerate on a horizontal road with an acceleration of $1.5\,\text{m/s}^2$. What is the net force acting on them?
A net force of $45\,\text{N}$ acts on an object, and its acceleration is $3.0\,\text{m/s}^2$. What is the mass of the object?

A box of mass $12\,\text{kg}$ is pulled on a horizontal floor with a horizontal force of $38\,\text{N}$. The friction force from the floor on the box is $20\,\text{N}$. Draw the free-body diagram of the box. What is the acceleration of the box?
At a building site a bucket of mass $8.0\,\text{kg}$ is lifted straight up on a rope at constant velocity. Draw the free-body diagram of the bucket. What is the tension in the rope?

level2.text: A passenger car of mass $1200\,\text{kg}$ accelerates uniformly on a horizontal road from rest to a velocity of $90\,\text{km/h}$ in $10\,\text{s}$. What is the net force acting on the car during the acceleration?

An elevator car with its passengers has a mass of $900\,\text{kg}$. It starts to move downward with an acceleration of $1.5\,\text{m/s}^2$. What is the tension in the supporting rope during the acceleration?

A crane lowers a load of $120\,\text{kg}$ downward at a velocity of $2.0\,\text{m/s}$. Just before the ground the load slows down uniformly and stops in $2.0\,\text{s}$. What is the tension in the rope during the slowing down?

Two children pull a cart of $30\,\text{kg}$ in a horizontal yard with horizontal ropes in opposite directions. One pulls with a force of $60\,\text{N}$ and the other with a force of $45\,\text{N}$. Friction is ignored. What is the acceleration of the cart?

level3.text: A student of mass $60.0\,\text{kg}$ stands on a bathroom scale in an elevator. The scale measures the force with which it supports the student and shows it in kilograms, that is, divides the force by $9.81\,\text{m/s}^2$. When the elevator starts to move, the scale shows $54.0\,\text{kg}$ for a moment. What is the acceleration of the elevator, and in which direction does it point?

An empty timber truck of mass $10\,\text{t}$ accelerates uniformly from rest to a velocity of $36\,\text{km/h}$ in $8.0\,\text{s}$. Fully loaded, its mass is $25\,\text{t}$. Assume that the net force during the acceleration is the same as for the empty truck. How long does it take the loaded truck to accelerate from rest to $36\,\text{km/h}$?

A child slides on a sled on horizontal snow. The total mass of the sled and the child is $30\,\text{kg}$, and the velocity is $4.0\,\text{m/s}$ at the start. Nobody pulls or pushes the sled. The friction force from the snow is $18\,\text{N}$, and air resistance is not taken into account. How long does it take before the sled stops?
